implemented.preAdmission: Admit actual frame/bounds/copy structures before the original root map, content-bound callback, corner arrays, native coordinate maps, union records, header input and layer-map factories. Plain evaluated graph topology supplies concrete counts of draw nodes, isolates and isolate children. This prepass does not invoke content-bound callbacks or change native operators; borrowed provider/shape geometry remains caller-owned.

declaredCapacities.temporaryOriginalProducers: 384 + 120*rootOps + 512*draws + 64*(isolates+isolateChildren). The 384 base covers controller/frame/header-input/owner/bounds/layer arrays. Each root operation declares original row and bounds/layer/owner-array slots. Each draw declares 64 inline box + 384 corner/coordinate arrays + 64 transformed bounds. Each empty isolate and possible child union declares 64 bounds bytes. These are concrete producer bounds, not a scene-size multiplier.
declaredCapacities.retainedFrame: After original bounds/header/layer producers finish and temporary references drop: 320 base + 112*rootLayers + 64*definedRootBounds. Native key text owners reserve separately.

implemented.keysAndRetention: Original header/layer visual serialization returns owned keys; current frame records retain them across scratch cleanup. The previous complete frame remains owned through actual key/order/bounds comparison and then releases. Original full/unchanged/dirty behavior, mask/matte coverage, union/rounding/clamping and authored ordering remain unchanged.
implemented.consumerLifetime: Changed-bounds pair arrays admit before construction and release after consumption. The original dirty spread admits before construction. Its owner persists through the actual backend frame consumer; endFrame first clears the device clip reference, then finish releases the owner. Reusable reset and final disposal release frame keys/controls and dirty owners.
implemented.failureCleanup: Quota denial precedes native map/content-bound producers. Failed callbacks and partial original native key serialization preserve the prior complete frame and original null reasons while incomplete keys/arrays/controls release. Unsupported nested geometry clears retained frame metadata. Caller-owned geometry is not adopted or destroyed. Allocator-first disposal is idempotent.
implemented.scope: Selected WebGL damage key output, concrete original bounds/copy structures and retained controls. Vector/provider keys, retained graphs, font and other checksum structures, ledger controls, Node protocol/result copies and actual production/aggregate admission remain pending. Native VM/codec/driver/crypto private storage and RSS are separate.
